pronunciation.tip: 妈 (mum), 麻 (hemp), 马 (horse), 骂 (scold) — same MA, four words! Sing the tones!

pronunciation.t: j/q/x: tongue flat behind lower teeth
pronunciation.tip: Smile wide! 鸡 (ji = chicken), 七 (qi = seven), 西 (xi = west). Never English J!

pronunciation.t: zh/ch/sh curl back, z/c/s stay flat
pronunciation.tip: 知 (zhī = know) curls; 子 (zǐ = child) stays flat. Two sets — train both!

pronunciation.t: ü rounds lips like French U
pronunciation.tip: 绿 (lǜ = green), 女 (nǚ = woman). Say EE with rounded lips!

pronunciation.t: Neutral tone goes light and quick
pronunciation.tip: 妈妈 (māma) — second MA is light! 谢谢 (xièxie) — second Xie floats!

alphabet.title: Pinyin initials: your sound map
alphabet.explain: Chinese characters don't show sound — PINYIN (Roman letters) does! Master these 23 initials + 4 tones and you can pronounce ANYTHING. Characters come with every word — learn sound and shape together!

counting.title: Counting 0 to 100
counting.explain: Simplest system ever! 1–10, then stack: 11 = 十一 (10-1), 20 = 二十 (2-10s), 21 = 二十一. 100 = 一百. Learn 10 words, count to 100!
rules: Tens = number + 十: 二十 = 20. 21 = 二十一 — pure stacking!

lessons.title: 是 and 这/那
lessons.learn: Point! 这 (this), 那 (that). 这是书 = This is a book. Negative: 不是 (is not). Adjectives need 很: 很好 (very-good = good), 很大 (big)! 没有很 = sounds wrong!

grammar.title: 这是X · 不是 · 很 + adj

grammar.pattern: 这/那 + 是 + X · 很 + adj
mistakes: Saying 这书 — 是 required: 这是书!
Saying 大书 for 'big' — pair adjectives: 大书 ok, but predicate needs 很大!

lessons.title: Verbs never change: 吃
lessons.learn: The BEST news: Chinese verbs NEVER conjugate! 我吃 (I eat), 你吃 (you eat), 他吃 (he eats) — same 吃! Negative: 不吃 (don't eat). Doing-now: 在吃 (am eating). Time words do everything!

grammar.title: No conjugation: 不 · 在 · 了
grammar.explain: 我吃面包 (I eat bread), 我不吃 (I don't eat), 我在吃 (I am eating), 我吃了 (I ate — 了 = completed)! Same verb, tiny helpers!

mistakes: Changing 吃 for he/she — verbs NEVER change!
Saying 不了 — completed-negative: 没吃 (didn't eat)!

lessons.title: 有 / 没有
lessons.learn: HAVE = 有! 我有书 (I have a book). Don't-have = 没有 (NOT 不有!): 我没有钱 (I have no money). AT somewhere: 在: 我在家 (I'm at home). 是 = is, 在 = at, 有 = have — three pillars!

grammar.title: 有/没有 · 在 (at)
grammar.explain: 我有书 (I have a book), 你有水吗? (do you have water?), 我没有钱 (no money). Location: 书在桌子上 (the book is on the table)!
grammar.pattern: 有/没有 + thing · 在 + place
mistakes: Saying 不有 — don't-have is 没有 (one word)!
Saying 我是在家 — at-home: 我在家 (no 是)!
